Act, No. 8 of 2017
440C. (1) Notwithstanding anything to the
contrary in this Code or any other law, it shall
not  be  necessary  to  adduce  proof  of  any
document  which  is,  ex  facie,  an  original
document or a certified copy issued by a Public
Office, Public Corporation, Provincial Council
or any Local  Authority, unless the authority
of  such  document  is  impeached  by  the
opposing party for reasons to be recorded and
for such reasons, the court may require proof
thereof.
(2) Where the genuineness of any document
is impeached by a party, such party shall state
the reason for impeaching its genuineness and
the court shall record the same.
(3) In the event that the court, after evidence
is lead as to the proof of the document, accepts
the  document,  the  party  who  impeached  the
document shall be liable to pay incurred cost
of proving the document, in addition to taxed
costs, unless the court for good reason directs
otherwise.”.
